strings.name: Michael Jackson
strings.role: Singer and dancer · A major figure in pop music and music videos
strings.summary: Michael Jackson developed from a Jackson 5 child star into a global pop figure, bringing together rhythm and blues, pop, rock, dance and music videos. His major albums include Off the Wall, Thriller and Bad. His stage performances and visual productions influenced popular culture. His life also involved controversies including allegations of child sexual abuse; a jury acquitted him of all charges in his 2005 criminal trial.
strings.coverageNote: Focuses on his musical career during his lifetime and the outcome of the 2005 criminal trial. Allegations or opinions beyond judicial findings are not presented as established facts.

strings.facts.fact-02.label: Early experience
strings.facts.fact-02.value: Singer in the family group Jackson 5
strings.facts.fact-03.label: Notable albums
strings.highlights.highlight-01.title: Bringing music and film together
strings.highlights.highlight-01.text: Works such as Thriller expanded the expressive possibilities of popular songs through narrative music videos.
strings.highlights.highlight-02.title: Eight Grammys in one ceremony
strings.highlights.highlight-02.text: Won eight Grammy Awards in one night in 1984, with thirteen wins over his solo career.
strings.timeline.event-01.title: Dies
strings.timeline.event-01.text: Died in 2009; his recordings, stage performances and music videos continued to influence later popular culture.
strings.timeline.event-02.title: Acquitted in criminal trial
strings.timeline.event-02.text: The jury acquitted him on all charges in a trial involving child sexual abuse and related allegations.
strings.timeline.event-03.title: Enters the Rock & Roll Hall of Fame as a solo artist
strings.timeline.event-03.text: Inducted for his solo achievements after entering with the Jackson 5 in 1997.
strings.timeline.event-04.title: Releases Bad
strings.timeline.event-04.text: Released a new studio album, continuing an approach that combined singing, dance and visual production.
strings.timeline.event-05.title: Takes part in a charity music project
strings.timeline.event-05.text: Participated in We Are the World and USA for Africa to raise money for famine relief in Africa.
strings.timeline.event-06.title: Wins eight Grammys in one night
strings.timeline.event-06.text: Set the then-record for awards in a single ceremony at the 26th Grammy Awards.
strings.timeline.event-07.title: The moonwalk becomes a signature move
strings.timeline.event-07.text: A televised dance performance closely associated the move with his public image.
strings.timeline.event-08.title: Releases Thriller
strings.timeline.event-08.text: Combined several musical styles and expanded the album’s global influence through carefully produced music videos.
strings.timeline.event-09.title: Releases Off the Wall
strings.timeline.event-09.text: The album made with Quincy Jones became an important breakthrough in his adult solo career.
strings.timeline.event-10.title: Begins a solo recording career
strings.timeline.event-10.text: After success with his family group, began recording as a solo singer and later released works including Ben.
strings.timeline.event-11.title: Born in Gary
strings.timeline.event-11.text: Born in Indiana, United States, and performed as a child with his brothers in the Jackson 5.
